name: Wermelskirchen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wermelskirchen (a tree and a black swan above a church).
history: Municipal flag of Wermelskirchen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wermelskirchen arms — tree, swan and church
